candidats.description: Descaling device for use in kettles etc. The dissolved calcium settles on the large surface of the stainless steel mesh and no longer on the walls of the kettle. Depending on the water hardness, the descaler needs to be decalcified every few weeks - either by mechanical kneading under running water or with the usual descaling agents. Left picture: Just decalcified descaler Right picture: Condition after several weeks of use.
